import HartshorneLib.Chapter4LocalTaylorCoefficients
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Derivation.Basic

/-!
# Differentiating local Taylor coefficients

A derivation taking the specified local parameter to one differentiates its
Taylor coefficients by the usual formula, in arbitrary characteristic.
This is the local differentiation identity used in residue calculations
(Hartshorne III.7.14.1).
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Hartshorne

open IsLocalRing

noncomputable section

variable {k R : Type*} [Field k] [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
  [IsLocalRing R] [Algebra k R]
variable (c0 : R →ₗ[k] k)
  (hc0 : ∀ a : R, residue R (algebraMap k R (c0 a)) = residue R a)
  (t : R) (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (ht : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span {t})
  (d : Derivation k R R) (hdt : d t = 1)

include hdt

/-- Differentiating the constant-term removal identity expresses the
derivative using the local Taylor remainder. -/
theorem derivation_eq_localTaylorRemainder (a : R) :
    d a = localTaylorRemainder c0 hc0 t ht0 ht a +
      t * d (localTaylorRemainder c0 hc0 t ht0 ht a) := by
  have h := congrArg d (mul_localTaylorRemainder c0 hc0 t ht0 ht a)
  simpa only [map_sub, Derivation.leibniz, Derivation.map_algebraMap,
    hdt, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, sub_zero, add_comm] using h.symm

/-- The coefficient of degree `n` of the derivative is `n + 1` times
the coefficient of degree `n + 1`, without a characteristic restriction. -/
theorem localTaylorCoefficient_derivation (n : ℕ) (a : R) :
    localTaylorCoefficient c0 hc0 t ht0 ht n (d a) =
      (n + 1 : k) * localTaylorCoefficient c0 hc0 t ht0 ht (n + 1) a := by
  induction n generalizing a with
  | zero =>
    rw [derivation_eq_localTaylorRemainder c0 hc0 t ht0 ht d hdt a,
      map_add, localTaylorCoefficient_zero, localTaylorCoefficient_zero,
      localConstantTerm_parameter_mul c0 hc0 t ht,
      localTaylorCoefficient_succ, localTaylorCoefficient_zero]
    simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [derivation_eq_localTaylorRemainder c0 hc0 t ht0 ht d hdt a,
      map_add, localTaylorCoefficient_succ_parameter_mul, ih]
    rw [← localTaylorCoefficient_succ]
    push_cast
    ring

end
end Hartshorne
